findings.statement: The capacity-gap model is a retrospective endpoint reference after invalidated strain grouping; it is not independent biological confirmation.
findings.applicability: Whole source laboratories; two development labs and one historically exposed GSK cohort; exact actual times and numeric equality targets only.
findings.limitations: Previously invalidated grouping exposed part of the GSK cohort; source strain/SITE alias inconsistencies make directory-level labs the only defensible existing group.
falsification: Do not turn interval-censored death times into scheduled 24 hresponses.
Exclude site/study/strain labels from numerical predictors under continuation task; retain them as provenance/group metadata.
Require time-resolved evidence for kinetics; separately evaluate baseline cohort uncertainty and humane endpoint selection.
findings.prior_art: Source already investigates multicenter virulence; endpointselection/identifiability audit is valuable but not a new pathogen law. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
